title: Verify the deployed production SHA against the release fingerprint
business_value: Closes BLK-PRODUCTION-SHA so every later release claim can be graded 'verified' instead of 'reported'; prevents a stale production from being mistaken for the canonical build.
objective: Record in .ai/CURRENT_STATE.json which commit production serves, graded 'verified', using the public version endpoint and a local build of the same commit.

in: LOVABLE_SANDBOX=1 bun run build at the base SHA

inputs.name: Release fingerprint evidence
inputs.purpose: Expected fingerprint d064be7f74d8… for the corrective release

steps.action: Fetch /api/public/version from production and record releaseId, fingerprint, builtAt
Build the base SHA locally and compare the embedded fingerprint
steps.evidence_required: build log line with the fingerprint

steps.action: Write production.deployed_sha and evidence_grade='verified' with source into .ai/CURRENT_STATE.json; set BLK-PRODUCTION-SHA status to closed
Run bun run ai:check and the full gate set
Commit to main with the full SHA in the handoff

rollback: Revert the documentation-only commit; no runtime, schema or deployment change.
